drug_class: Angiotensin Receptor-Neprilysin Inhibitor (ARNI) / Heart Failure Medication
purpose: This medication is used to treat heart failure, specifically when your heart is not pumping as well as it should. It helps reduce your risk of ending up in the hospital because of heart failure and can help you live longer. Your doctor may prescribe it if your heart is weak and not working at full strength.
how_it_works: This medicine is actually two medicines working together as a team. One part (valsartan) blocks a chemical in your body that makes your blood vessels tight and causes your heart to work harder. The other part (sacubitril) helps build up natural substances in your body that relax your blood vessels and help your kidneys remove extra fluid. Together, they take pressure off your heart and make it easier for your heart to pump blood.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects include low blood pressure (which can make you feel dizzy or lightheaded, especially when standing up quickly), high potassium levels in your blood, and kidney problems. Some people may also experience a dry cough or feel tired. Let your doctor know if any of these bother you.
warnings: Do NOT take this medication if you are pregnant — it can seriously harm or even kill an unborn baby. Do not take it together with a medication called an ACE inhibitor (like lisinopril or enalapril), and wait at least 36 hours between stopping an ACE inhibitor and starting this medicine. Also avoid it if you have ever had a serious allergic reaction called angioedema (swelling of the face, lips, throat, or tongue) with a similar medicine. Tell your doctor about all other medications you take, especially potassium supplements or water pills.
typical_dosing: Most people start at a lower dose of 24mg/26mg (one tablet) twice a day — once in the morning and once in the evening. Your doctor will likely increase your dose over time, aiming for the full dose of 97mg/103mg twice a day, as long as your body tolerates it well. Always take it as prescribed, and try to take it at the same times each day. It can be taken with or without food.
